switches.desc_en: Toggles the damage formula between difference (attack−defense, clamped at 1) and ratio (ratio_k·attack/(attack+defense)). Off=difference (default), On=ratio. Weak-vs-strong fights stop being a flat floor.
switches.desc_zh: 切换伤害公式:差值口径(attack−defense,下限 1)与比值口径(ratio_k·attack/(attack+defense))。Off=difference(缺省),On=ratio;弱打强不再被钳底。

switches.desc_en: Enables a no-combat growth channel: players spend some sessions training for xp/gold. Off=no training (default), On=behavior p_training>0 plus a training output table.
switches.desc_zh: 开启无战斗风险的成长通道:玩家部分会话用于练级换经验/金币。Off=无练级环(缺省),On=各分群 p_training>0 且配置 training 产出面。

switches.desc_en: Adds a post-victory weighted-table draw that scales reward amounts. Off=no loot (default), On=loot table bound on victory.
switches.desc_zh: 战斗胜利后从绑定加权表抽一次,按 rate_mult 缩放数额入账。Off=未配置掉落(缺省),On=配置 loot 表并在胜利结算。

switches.desc_en: Adds a pity-layered gacha draw; every player pulls until a 5★. Off=no gacha (default), On=gacha config with hard pity.
switches.desc_zh: 接入抽卡保底:每玩家开号抽到 5★ 为止。Off=未配置抽卡(缺省),On=配置 gacha 保底(2% 基础率 + 50 抽硬保底)。
